evidence.source: Paper section 2.2 and SI synthesis identify oPmPCZ, formula C44H28N4, and CCDC deposition 2466817.

Paper section 2.3 and the SI theoretical-calculation paragraph establish that an optimized isolated molecule and excited states are scientifically applicable; the autonomous mode supplies no author method.

Paper Fig. 2c and section 2.3 identify S1, T1, T6, and T7, but do not provide source-readable standalone numerical energies for all four; evaluation checks reported energies, units, and assignments rather than inventing targets.
Paper section 2.3, page 3, reports calculated S1-T1 gap 0.93 eV.
Paper section 2.3, page 4, reports SOC(S1,T6)=0.362, SOC(S1,T7)=0.215, and SOC(S1,T1)=0.073 cm^-1.
Paper section 2.3 supports interpreting energetic proximity and larger higher-triplet SOCs as higher-triplet-access evidence; autonomous research must derive and bound its own interpretation.
